title: Battery failure mid-route
description: Two delivery drones get battery faults mid-route. @cargo1 loses a cell at 70 s: the cell imbalance takes the BMS to CRITICAL, the DTC gives it right of way and reserves its landing pad, and it diverts. @cargo2 (31 % charge) loses 30 % of its capacity at 80 s; its BMS does not know this and has to learn it from the falling voltage, so it diverts on low reserve about a minute later. At 85 s the operator grounds every drone still at BMS CRITICAL.
timeline: @cargo1 Sampoorna → SNCC (2.3 km, 80 % SoC); @cargo2 Main Gate → New Hostels (31 % SoC)
@cargo1 cell failure → BMS CRITICAL, right of way, pad reserved, diverts
@cargo2 loses 30 % capacity (unknown to its BMS) → low-reserve diversion once the BMS learns it
